decisions.summary: A .drawing.html listed under Entry: is refused at parse, the message naming Drawing:
decisions.why: Enforcement test: a guard that REFUSES, so its reach was measured. _base.py:331 sits inside _about_feature, so it refuses only an About-form modal (the 149 old-form files still listing drawing pages under Entry: today parse untouched), and only on the '.drawing.html' substring of Entry:, which is exactly the set of 'how our maps draw it' pages. Entry: is what sources.research_questions puts on the References tab, so the refusal enforces FR-006 and SC-008 ('no References tab lists a how our maps draw it page') and nothing else; delete that requirement and the refusal has nothing to check. Refusing at import is the established form for every other About-form error (Label:, old prose tags). No reach beyond the request.

decisions.summary: The modal-depiction bundle carries a screenshot crop of the glyph on a pool page (fixed zoom, the page tests' browser); a kind on no pool map bundled without one, saying so
decisions.why: Enforcement test: an INPUT to the requested check, not new behavior - it refuses, blocks and rewrites nothing. FR-014 asks the check to judge the tab 'as drawn' and that 'nothing is claimed that is not drawn'; the drawing pages say what the rules are, the crop is the only thing in the bundle that shows what the glyph actually looks like. Delete the Depiction check and the crop has nothing to serve. The session pitched 'a crop of the glyph' to the GM before his 2026-10-04 reply, which raised no objection. The no-crop fallback does not skip the check (pages and claims rows still go in).

Does it do what it says: measured in dev/claims-index.json, the farmhouse's DRIFTED rows (HousesMixin.house#farmhouse glyph, #ridge at 0.6 of the length - the roof shape knob, #big farmhouse wing) all cite 0029-farmhouses-minka.drawing.html, so the filter reaches the single-roof drift the plan names.

decisions.summary: modal-research no longer reads the drawing pages; its Entry is research questions only
decisions.why: Follows FR-006: References now holds research questions alone, so modal-research's REFERENCES check against drawing pages would test a list the spec moved away. Nothing FR-008 or FR-014 asks goes unchecked: Depiction statements and links are judged by modal-depiction against the drawing pages, the crop and the claims rows; a drawing page that changes owes modal-depiction (D13); About statements still rest on research questions (M13/M14). Not a narrowing. Housekeeping for T20: .claude/agents/modal-research.md line 42 still says 'A drawing page is listed only if a statement rests on it'.

decisions.summary: modal-depiction owed when the modal's Depiction or Drawing changed or a page under Drawing: changed (implemented in scripts/_modal_owed.py:249 only for a modal that HAS the tab: 'a converted modal without one never owes')
decisions.why: FR-014 owes the check 'by a changed modal or drawing page'; SC-008 requires 'every rewritten modal whose kind has a drawing page or a convention carries a Depiction tab that has passed modal-depiction'. The plan owes it only when Depiction/Drawing moved, and the code gates it on the tab existing. The failure is concrete and is the rollout itself: 149 old-form modals list drawing pages under Entry: today; a conversion that drops them and writes no Depiction: leaves Depiction/Drawing empty-to-empty, so modal-depiction is never owed, modal-research no longer reads drawing pages, modal-form cannot know a drawing page exists - and the modal lands with no Depiction tab, its drawing pages and conventions silently gone, every check green. That is the exact case FR-014's COVERAGE criterion and SC-008 exist for, and T20's own proof ('it must flag the missing tab') is a finding the owed machinery would never dispatch the check to make. Not physically impossible (owe it on any change to an About-form modal file, and on conversion), not implied by the GM's words, and the literal reading defeats nothing. Required change: owe modal-depiction for every About-form modal on ANY change to its file (including new to the About form) and when a page under Drawing: changes, whether or not the tab exists - FR-014's trigger as written - and drop the m.depiction.strip() gate.
